interest: This file is interesting to diplomatic and military historians because it documents U.S. military intelligence tracking of Japanese military diplomacy and presence in the Near East and Southeastern Europe during the interwar period. Although the underlying intelligence document was retained or filed elsewhere, this List of Papers docket sheet preserves the record of U.S. Military Attaché Report No. 6647 from Turkey regarding a Japanese military mission visiting Turkey in July 1934. It illustrates both the scope of Japanese overseas military missions in the 1930s and the State Department's cross-referencing and indexing practices for War Department Military Intelligence Division (G-2) reports under decimal classification 894.2340.
overview: This file comprises a single docket sheet ('List of Papers') for U.S. Department of State decimal file 894.2340, classified under 'Entrance Of Military Bodies And Aircraft Of Japan Into Europe In Transit Or On Visit.' The sheet records a single communication: a report from the U.S. Military Attaché in Turkey (Report No. 6647, dated July 2, 1934, misread in the OCR header as 1954) entitled 'Turkey (Combat) Report: Military missions. Japanese mission visits Turkey.' The underlying War Department intelligence report is not enclosed in the file, leaving this purport entry as the surviving record of the Japanese military delegation's visit to Turkey.

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording a U.S. Military Attaché intelligence report on a Japanese military mission visiting Turkey.
subfiles.summary: This docket sheet ('List of Papers') serves as the index record for decimal file 894.2340 regarding Japanese military visits to Europe. It indexes sub-number 1, a combat intelligence report (No. 6647) originated by the U.S. Military Attaché in Turkey on July 2, 1934 (erroneously transcribed in the OCR header as 1954). The purport notes a report on military missions detailing that a Japanese mission visited Turkey. The report itself is not included in the microfilm file, making this entry the primary State Department index record of the event.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Visits of Japanese Military Bodies to Europe
